Aggressive preset removes nav, footer, aside unconditionally

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<nav>Menu</nav><article><h1>Title</h1><p>Content</p></article><aside>Sidebar</aside><footer>Footer</footer>", "{\"preprocessing\":{\"preset\":\"Aggressive\"}}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
